text:
jordan: Heads up — we need to lock the announcement runway for the GenX GPU co-marketing with Nimbus Systems + Azure Marketplace listing. Can we pick dates & MDF split this week?

priya: Proposed window: Nov 8–22 (6-week prep). Nimbus is asking for a week-of-Nov-15 embargo. Marketplace listing needs 2 weeks for validation. Rough timeline below:
```
Oct 25 - Nimbus provides test image
Oct 26 - Marketplace validation kickoff
Nov 1  - Marketing assets deadline
Nov 15 - Nimbus press embargo window opens
Nov 20 - Marketplace listing live (target)
Nov 22 - Joint blog + PR
```

mike: Marketplace note: listing slot available Nov 20. Validation needs ~10 business days. We can expedite if we get a test image by Oct 25 and a minimal manifest. @lena can marketing commit to Nov 20?

lena: We can hit Nov 20 if assets are in by Nov 1. Need MDF confirmation by Oct 28 to lock the PR agency and paid placements. Also need logo + release rights.

ethan: Finance check — Q4 MDF pool currently ~$180k. We can carve out $50k for this co-invest if Nimbus is approved for a silver-tier uplift. Need updated partner scorecard and a signed LOA.

jordan: Uploading draft scorecard now — key asks: uplift Nimbus to Silver for co-investment (revenue + pipeline). Scorecard targets: joint pipeline $150k, 3 customer references, 1 marketplace-certified workload. Add contingency: carryover clause if listing delayed.

priya: I'll update the scorecard. Two operational asks: (1) SI integration checklist — partner team must submit acceptance tests by Nov 5. (2) Fallback plan: if marketplace misses Nov 20, we run a hardware-first partner spotlight and delay the joint blog until listing completes.

ops-bot: Reminder: please create PR brief in #marketing-assets. Template command: `/create_brief Nimbus-GenX`

mike: Marketplace can prioritize validation if we get a `container-image` + test dataset. Staging docs: https://marketplace.docs/validation — share creds with me once uploaded.

lena: Looping in PR agency contact in DM. @ethan — can legal sign off on co-marketing terms by Oct 30? We need the legal OK before committing paid placements.

ethan: Legal pinged (legal@redwood.com). We can do review but need LOA from Nimbus and the proposed ad copy.

priya: Action items summary (from this thread):
1) Jordan: finalize & share scorecard draft (done).
2) Nimbus: deliver test image by Oct 25.
3) Marketing: final assets by Nov 1.
4) Finance: confirm MDF transfer of $50k by Oct 28.
5) Marketplace: validation kickoff Oct 26.
I'll schedule a 30-min sync Fri 10/20 10am PT to confirm blockers. Anyone can't make it?

mike: Works for me.

lena: Works :thumbsup:

jordan: Also — please include an escalation contact for marketplace validation (if it stalls). @mike — can you be point?

mike: Yep, use me (mike, marketplace-pm). I'll add a Kanban board and a validation owner.

jordan: Great. I'll update the partner_ops drive with the timeline and scorecard, and follow up with Nimbus for the LOA. If anything slips we trigger the fallback plan.

priya: Thanks all — will post the updated scorecard + calendar invite in this channel once scheduled.
